summary_1line: Markandeya foretells the moral, social, and cosmic decline of humanity in the Kali Yuga while explaining the progressive weakening of virtue across the four ages.

image_candidates.scene_text: At the cosmic end of the age, frightened sages scatter like crows, fleeing across mountains and rivers from violent, lawless men.
The bull of morality stands crippled with only one remaining leg as darkness spreads over the world in the Kali age.
Oppressed Brahmanas wander the earth in fear, while corrupt rulers and quarrelling crowds fill the cities with chaos.
